make sure to keep the README.md updated. do not create other README files. 
make sure to always update the .env.example file when adding new environment variables. do not add new environment variables without updating the .env.example file.
make sure to update the deploy.yml file to include any new environment variables added to the .env.example file. do not add new environment variables without updating the deploy.yml file.
make sure to always update or add new language keys in the lang.php file when adding new text to the application. do not add new text without updating the lang.php file.
